description: Retrieve semantic memory profile (attributes, preferences, evolving persona, interaction episodes) for a user or agent from Evermind.

memory_type.description: Type of memory: 'profile' (semantic traits) or 'episode' (historical conversation traces)

session_id.description: Optional session ID to scope episode retrieval

user_id.description: User ID to fetch profile/episodes for (defaults to authenticated caller username)

name: lokha_memory_get_profile
